'''1999 Decipher World Championship Bastian Winkelhaus DS''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Bastian Winkelhaus]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds95.htm The Most Fearsome Deck At The Worlds], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228002944/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds95.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]

* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif}}
* '''Event:''' [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]
